name: RUMBLE_STRIPS_YELLOW_DIAMOND

Size A 600 diamond generated (B 750, C 900 also tabled): a 600 side drawn as the bounding square 848.53, r 40, b 10 yellow edge + c 20 black border (separate spans on the sheet, as the national W-series 10 + 20 at 600). Legend two lines d 110C (Series C, cap 110), gap e 50, the pair centred on the horizontal centreline as drawn (d above / e / d below the centreline): cap tops 289.27 and 449.27 (424.27 - 135 and + 25). Black on Class 400 retroreflective yellow.
